title: 1940s Uncle Lester at Massillon State Hospital Ohio, B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Uncle Lester - worked & lived in the grounds Massillon State Hosp. I was there once. We came by on the way home from Aunt Lucia's funeral. Leroy drove took Aunt Sarah, Nip & Nana & me
description: A vintage black and white snapshot featuring a man identified as Uncle Lester standing outside an arched entryway on the grounds of Massillon State Hospital in Ohio, taken circa 1940. The subject is wearing a white dress shirt, tie, and slacks with his hands in his pockets. On the front edge, a handwritten note reads 'This is where he lived' with two inked 'X' marks above windows indicating his living quarters. The reverse side features handwritten context details about the family visit following a funeral.
